headline: Expand Energy (EXE) Stock Still Looks Undervalued On Its 115% Five Year Run
summary: Expand Energy has delivered a 115.4% total return over the past five years, yet the stock is down 9.0% over the last year and carries a strong value score, which raises a clear question about how cheap the current share price really is. A 115.4% return over five years suggests long term holders have been rewarded, even though more recent returns have softened.
